You might know me as your friendly help desk assistant.
And if we haven't met yet, it's nice to meet you!
Today, I'm here to tell you a little bit about BoldDesk.

BoldDesk is a support platform designed to give teams a better way to manage requests, communicate with the employees and customers they support, and keep track of the work happening across their team.
The idea is One Northpointe Support Experience.
Here's the basic idea: an email sent to a support team becomes a ticket.
The team member working that ticket is the agent, and they have everything they need in one place.
So, why BoldDesk? And how can it help teams across Northpointe?
